nextSearch.newInformation: Factory getPool results for untested event tokens against WETH and USDG across the supported fee tiers, including whether older companion pools exist. Discovery alone would not establish quote quality or profitability.
nextSearch.reason: The repeated failures are measured negative gross results in the tested clusters, while all availableCells are empty and suspended clusters have no new positive known-net measurements. Expanding the pool universe addresses this by probing previously untested event tokens and discovering older companion pools, rather than proposing another fee permutation or changing entry rules.
